The '''Deserter's Hideout''' is camp located north of Tabetha's Farm in the [[Quagmire]] of [[Dustwallow Marsh]]. It is inhabited by [[Daelin's Brigade]], a group of [[Theramore deserters]] that is actively hostile to prospects of peace between the [[Alliance]] and [[Horde]].
